top_signals.title: CISA warns of PHP bug exploitation attempts, gives federal agencies days to patch
top_signals.summary: CISA added the widely publicized PHP vulnerabilities to the KEV, but didn't specify what kind of exploitation it was observing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Australia’s spies are sharing intelligence with hacking targets — and want them to share back
top_signals.summary: More than half of the individual warnings from the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) drew on previously secret material that had been cleared for disclosure, underscoring the growing role of intelligence sharing to prevent attacks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
